_comment: Input to _splice-fragments.mjs. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand. Copy rules for this namespace: the read line must never imply we fetched the full article (subscription publishers paywall their bodies and we only ever see the title, the English description and existing enrichment), so no locale says 'we read the article'. The boost is a weight on an existing preference row and is deliberately small, so the copy says 'more weight in your feed', never 'at the top'. {{publisher}} is an interpolation and is copied verbatim. zh-TW uses the formal 您.
